title: The GLP-1 gold rush
brief: An investor/executive deck on the weight-loss drug market in July 2026: the GLP-1 mechanism in one slide, a market sized toward $200B by 2030 (~10M US patients now, 1 in 8 adults), the Eli Lilly vs Novo Nordisk duel with real Q1-2026 revenue and share data, the pipeline race (oral orforglipron/Foundayo, CagriSema, Amgen MariTide, Roche, Viking, Chinese mazdutide/ribupatide), the MFN price reset and FDA compounding fight, the second-order shockwaves in food & beverage, snacking, bariatric surgery and devices, the supply/manufacturing build-out, the risks (adherence, patent cliff, pricing pressure, crowding), and a reasoned outlook. Every dated figure web-grounded with a full sources slide; not investment advice.
da: Modern pharma brand — warm near-white #FBFBF9, graphite ink #1A1A1A, one capsule-coral accent #FF5A4D on key numerals and chart primaries, Manrope geometric grotesk with very large stat numerals, crisp cards and thin neutral rules; clinical-but-commercial.
